# Test Vectors for the BIP-139 Wallet Export Format (draft for upstream submission)

**Status:** draft text block, prepared by the Dana Wallet project
(https://github.com/Sosthene00/dana). Target: the BIP-139 draft
(bitcoin/bips PR #2130, draft as of 2026-11). The BIP-139 draft currently
publishes no test vectors; these were generated by Dana's reference
implementation from a fixed set of test keys and are reproducible from
Dana's open-source implementation. This file is a submission draft — the
BIP editors may reformat; the bytes are normative.

Vectors V1–V3 below are pure BIP-139 export payloads and are proposed for
adoption as BIP-139 test vectors. The Dana container vectors (V4–V5a)
are included for completeness of the compliance artifact; they exercise
Dana's encrypted container around a BIP-139 payload and are not proposed
as BIP-139 vectors.

Fixed test keys (secp256k1 scalars, hex):

- scan secret: `1111…1111` (0x11 × 32)
- spend secret: `2222…2222` (0x22 × 32)

The watch-only `sp()` scan descriptor and the full `sp()` spend descriptor
in the payloads are derived from exactly these keys by the reference
implementation.

---

## VECTOR-1 — Minimal payload

Smallest valid file: minimal BIP-139 export (single bip392 account, no labels) + REQUIRED secrets block, no optional section.

BIP-139 export payload (the §0x00000001 section body, UTF-8 JSON):

```json
{
  "accounts": [
    {
      "descriptor": "sp(spscan1qqg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zyg3zqjxd4lu4etruh9sngx3su9mtqp5fqzxz7re59y5nnez9p03ht3lyur8zmgr)#z58p7wne",
```

## Dana container vectors (informational, not proposed as BIP-139 vectors)


Dana wraps the BIP-139 payload in an encrypted container (cleartext
authenticated header as AEAD AAD || ciphertext || tag; XChaCha20-Poly1305;
Argon2id m=65536 KiB, t=3, p=1; HKDF-SHA256 purpose string "Dana backup
v1 AEAD key"). Full format: Dana's `docs/specs/encrypted-file-backup.md` §3–§5.

## dana-backup-v1-vector-5 — Corrupted-header-AAD decryption failure — corrupted header AAD (argon2_t)

- **Spec reference:** docs/specs/encrypted-file-backup.md §9 vector 5 (§3.2)
- **Description:** Vector 2 with one flipped bit in a non-magic header byte (argon2_t): tag verification fails against the tampered AAD, no partial plaintext, defined error code.

| field | value |
|---|---|
| password | `standard two-section vector 2` |
| password that decrypts the file | `standard two-section vector 2` |
| cipher_id | 1 (XChaCha20-Poly1305) |
| Argon2id | m = 65536 KiB, t = 3, p = 1 |
| salt (hex) | `766563746f722d73616c742d30303031` |
| nonce (hex) | `766563746f722d6e6f6e63652d3030303030303030303031` (nonce_len = 24) |
| derived AEAD key (hex) | `dc3abce87311e065b9cf70dc1178606181fcd23990150340b49155f950387f05` |
| expected outcome | decrypt_error, error code `AuthenticationFailed` |
| derived from | `dana-backup-v1-vector-2` |
| mutation | flipped bit 0 of header byte 0x14 (argon2_t low byte) (header offset 0x14, bit 0) |

## Reproducibility


Every vector above is regenerated and byte-verified against the reference
implementation on every test run (`backup_vectors::tests::
checked_in_vectors_regenerate_byte_identical`). Salt, nonce, passwords, and
test keys are pinned; nothing depends on OS randomness.
